description.narrative: Key stakeholders (rightsholders and dutybearers identified based on stakeholder analysis and RBA) are mobilized in multistakeholder platforms and engaged in CC policy design and implementation at various levels. A National Climate Platform (NCP) is mobilized at the national level and regional multistakeholder Climate Action Groups (CAGs) are established in the target regions. title.narrative: Number of multistakeholder climate platforms.

description.narrative: A National Climate Platform (NCP) and 4 regional Climate Action Groups (CAGs) are mobilized at the national and regional levels (2021).

comment.narrative: An NCP 1 is established from various stakeholder groups. 78 representatives of central ministries parliamentary committees state platforms and regional authorities of target regions international development organizations educational institutions national and regional NGOs and private sector representatives are members of the NCP. About 66 of NCP members are women. Regional CAGs 4 are mobilized at regional levels in target regions from various stakeholder groups. Representatives of the central government at local levels regional authorities of target regions target municipalities NGOs CBOs youth unions ecoclubs educational institutionscolleges private sector and farmers cooperatives are members of the CAGs. Guria regional CAG has 20 members Imereti 37 Kakheti 49 and RachaLechkhumi 30 members. In total 136 representatives of various stakeholder groups in target regions are part of the regional CAGs. About 54 of CAG members are women about 30 are youth and 15 VG representatives.
